_comment: Mac + IBKR. Copy to config.json. The Mac is the broker: this file cannot select tastytrade or Schwab. This template is dry on the paper port 7497, and mode dry stays dry. ./run.sh paper sets paper for one launch. Real money (mode live, port 7496 for TWS or 4001 for IB Gateway, account set to the live id) also needs SPX_NOON_ALLOW_LIVE=1 and SPX_NOON_LIVE_ACCOUNT equal to that account in the environment; this file alone can never send a real order.
_rules: Version B only. 15m closes 12:00–1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Long nearest 75 delta. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. GTC close at debit x 1.30. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop. Live Schwab orders are not this file.
_wrap: Read-only log summary at 16:20 ET: python -m spx_noon wrap reads state/trades.csv. python -m spx_noon wrap --book live reads state/trades-live.csv instead. Neither sends orders. Client id 142 is reserved and unused by that job.
